title: Gift of Edentulus

fields.label: Function

body:
"Can be opened on Halloween

Some wonder how it is so clean..."

- Item Description


Description

The Gift of Edentulus was an item available for purchase at Ghoulish Goods for 2,499 Candy. It was capable of being opened on the 31st of October 2023.
